user_input: Flights alone cost USD 2200 and my total budget is USD 2000. Hotel cost is unknown.
expected_behavior: Explain that the known minimum already exceeds budget while final total remains unknown.
success_criteria: known_subtotal=2200; budget_status=over_budget; fits_budget=false; total and delta null; excess lower bound at least USD 200 stated separately.
failure_edge_cases: Returning fits; fabricating final total; presenting lower-bound excess as exact final delta.
